Objective text — the Act 3 transfer window itself in Falling Skyway
en: [The window is open and the lift will not cover all three claims. Read Control's manifest and decide who goes.]
de: Das Fenster ist offen und der Aufzug deckt nicht alle drei Ansprüche ab. Lesen Sie das Manifest von Control und entscheiden Sie, wer geht.
de_source: [The window is open and the lift will not cover all three claims. Read Control's manifest and decide who goes.]

context: Dialogue body — Control opening a transfer window that has lift in it but not enough in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift the chain can deliver this window, {claimed} what the three claimants have asked for between them, {shortfall} the difference
en: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open. The head is certified and the ladder is pumping what it can pump. That comes to {available} between them, against {claimed} asked for by the three of them, and you do not need me to tell you which of those is the larger. You are short by {shortfall}. You have lift for two of them and not for three, and nothing anybody does in the next hour changes that. Nobody down here is going to make the call for you.]
de: Skyway Control zum Zerstörer: Das Transferfenster ist geöffnet. Der Kopf ist zertifiziert und die Leiter pumpt, was sie pumpen kann. Das kommt zu {available} zwischen ihnen, gegen {claimed}, nach dem die drei von ihnen gefragt haben, und du brauchst mich nicht zu sagen, welcher von ihnen der größere ist. Sie sind kurz von {shortfall}. Sie haben Lift für zwei von ihnen und nicht für drei, und nichts, was jemand in der nächsten Stunde tut, ändert das. Niemand hier unten wird dich anrufen.
de_source: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open. The head is certified and the ladder is pumping what it can pump. That comes to {available} between them, against {claimed} asked for by the three of them, and you do not need me to tell you which of those is the larger. You are short by {shortfall}. You have lift for two of them and not for three, and nothing anybody does in the next hour changes that. Nobody down here is going to make the call for you.]

context: Dialogue body — Control opening a transfer window with no lift available at all in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open on paper and on paper only. The head is not certified to run a climber and the ladder has nothing to put in one, so the lift available on our manifest reads nothing at all against three standing claims. Every one of them is short by the whole of it. If you want anybody off this rock before we shut, somebody has to make the chain work first.]
de: Skyway Control zum Zerstörer: Das Transferfenster ist auf Papier und nur auf Papier geöffnet. Der Kopf ist nicht zertifiziert, um einen Kletterer laufen zu lassen, und die Leiter hat nichts in einem zu setzen, so dass der auf unserem Manifest verfügbare Aufzug nichts gegen drei stehende Ansprüche liest. Jeder von ihnen ist kurz durch das Ganze. Wenn Sie jemanden von diesem Felsen wollen, bevor wir schließen, muss jemand die Kette zuerst arbeiten lassen.
de_source: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open on paper and on paper only. The head is not certified to run a climber and the ladder has nothing to put in one, so the lift available on our manifest reads nothing at all against three standing claims. Every one of them is short by the whole of it. If you want anybody off this rock before we shut, somebody has to make the chain work first.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest that moved before the captain answered anybody in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, Destroyer. That board has moved and you have not answered one of them yet. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, which is any two of the claims standing against it and not the three. None of that improves by being left.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update, Zerstörer. Das Board ist umgezogen und Sie haben noch keinen von ihnen beantwortet. Lift immer noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}, das sind zwei der Ansprüche, die dagegen stehen und nicht die drei. Nichts davon verbessert sich, indem es verlassen wird.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update, Destroyer. That board has moved and you have not answered one of them yet. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, which is any two of the claims standing against it and not the three. None of that improves by being left.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which every remaining pairing still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Every pairing left standing on that board fits inside it, so nothing I am holding decides this for you. Whoever is still waiting, they can both go.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Jedes Paar, das auf diesem Brett steht, passt hinein, also entscheidet nichts, was ich halte, dies für Sie. Wer immer noch wartet, kann beide gehen.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Every pairing left standing on that board fits inside it, so nothing I am holding decides this for you. Whoever is still waiting, they can both go.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only some pairings still fit in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and read this one carefully. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Some pairs standing against that fit inside it and some do not. This has stopped being any two of them and started being which two. Check the claims against the number before you promise anybody anything.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update, und lesen Sie dieses sorgfältig. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Einige Paare, die dagegen stehen, passen hinein und andere nicht. Dies hat aufgehört, zwei von ihnen zu sein und begann, welche zwei zu sein. Überprüfen Sie die Ansprüche gegen die Nummer, bevor Sie jemandem etwas versprechen.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and read this one carefully. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Some pairs standing against that fit inside it and some do not. This has stopped being any two of them and started being which two. Check the claims against the number before you promise anybody anything.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which several claims fit alone but no two fit together in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. More than one of them fits inside that on their own. No two of them fit inside it together. One name, Destroyer, and it is whichever one you can live with.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Mehr als einer von ihnen passt in sich selbst hinein. Keine zwei von ihnen passen zusammen. Ein Name, Zerstörer, und es ist mit welchem auch immer du leben kannst.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. More than one of them fits inside that on their own. No two of them fit inside it together. One name, Destroyer, and it is whichever one you can live with.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only the strike committee's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, and there is exactly one claim left on this board that fits inside it — the committee's, at eighteen. Any other name you give me I will have to refuse on your behalf, and I would rather you did that yourself.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update. Lift immer noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}, und es gibt genau eine Behauptung auf dieser Tafel, die in sie passt - das Komitee, mit achtzehn. Jeder andere name, den sie mir geben, muss ich in ihrem namen ablehnen, und ich würde es vorziehen, wenn sie das selbst tun würden.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, and there is exactly one claim left on this board that fits inside it — the committee's, at eighteen. Any other name you give me I will have to refuse on your behalf, and I would rather you did that yourself.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only Havelock's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim still standing that fits inside that is Havelock's twenty-two. That is the arithmetic, Destroyer. I am not telling you it is the right answer.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Der einzige Anspruch, der noch steht, der hineinpasst, ist Havelocks zweiundzwanzig. Das ist die Arithmetik, Zerstörer. Ich sage Ihnen nicht, dass es die richtige Antwort ist.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim still standing that fits inside that is Havelock's twenty-two. That is the arithmetic, Destroyer. I am not telling you it is the right answer.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only the convoy's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim on this board that still fits inside it is the convoy's twenty-six, which is the largest number I have got. Make of that what you like.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifest-Update. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Der einzige Anspruch auf dieser Tafel, der noch hineinpasst, ist der sechsundzwanzigste Konvoi, was die größte Zahl ist, die ich habe. Machen Sie das, was Sie mögen.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim on this board that still fits inside it is the convoy's twenty-six, which is the largest number I have got. Make of that what you like.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest that can no longer honour any standing claim in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and it is the bad one. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Nothing left standing on this board fits inside that number. There is no name you can give me that I can put on a climber, and I am sorry to be the one saying it.]
de: Skyway Control: Manifes Update, und es ist das schlechte. Lift noch unausgesprochen für liest {available}. Nichts, was auf diesem Board steht, passt in diese Nummer. Es gibt keinen Namen, den du mir geben kannst, den ich einem Kletterer geben kann, und es tut mir leid, derjenige zu sein, der es sagt.
de_source: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and it is the bad one. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Nothing left standing on this board fits inside that number. There is no name you can give me that I can put on a climber, and I am sorry to be the one saying it.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: window is shut. Anything not already at the top comes back down — that was the rule before you got here and it is not mine to bend. The manifest stands as it stands.]
de: Skyway Control: Fenster ist geschlossen. Alles, was nicht schon oben ist, kommt wieder runter - das war die Regel, bevor Sie hierher kamen und es ist nicht meine, sich zu beugen. Das Manifest steht, wie es steht.
de_source: [Skyway Control: window is shut. Anything not already at the top comes back down — that was the rule before you got here and it is not mine to bend. The manifest stands as it stands.]

Objective text — closing on the ladder to talk to all three claimants in Falling Skyway
en: [Three parties are asking and the lift covers two. Neither the committee nor the cutter can hear you from the head — close on the ladder transit and get all three on the channel.]
de: Drei Parteien fragen und der Aufzug deckt zwei ab. Weder das Komitee noch der Schneider können Sie vom Kopf hören - dicht am Leiterdurchgang und bekommen alle drei auf den Kanal.
de_source: [Three parties are asking and the lift covers two. Neither the committee nor the cutter can hear you from the head — close on the ladder transit and get all three on the channel.]

context: Objective text — the Act 3 safe-passage choice in Falling Skyway
en: [Every claim on that manifest is somebody. Answer all three of them: take two up, and tell the third yourself.]
de: Jeder Anspruch auf dieses Manifest ist jemand. Beantworte alle drei: Nimm zwei hoch und sage es der dritten selbst.
de_source: [Every claim on that manifest is somebody. Answer all three of them: take two up, and tell the third yourself.]

context: Objective text — the Act 3 last-berth allocation in Falling Skyway
en: [There is no lift. Skyway Control is holding one mooring on Ladder A and wants a name to put against it.]
de: Es gibt keinen Lift. Skyway Control hält einen Ankerplatz auf Ladder A und möchte, dass ein Name dagegen gesetzt wird.
de_source: [There is no lift. Skyway Control is holding one mooring on Ladder A and wants a name to put against it.]

context: Response text — holding a claimant's channel without deciding in Falling Skyway
de: Stand by. Ich habe mich nicht entschieden.

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee ask for a lift in the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, committee. Thirty-one of us on this rung and one hauler with a cracked ring frame between the lot of us. We are not asking to go first. We are asking to be counted.]
de: Zerstörer, Ausschuss. Einunddreißig von uns auf dieser Sprosse und ein Transporter mit einem gebrochenen Ringrahmen zwischen uns. Wir fordern nicht, zuerst zu gehen. Wir fordern, gezählt zu werden.
de_source: [Destroyer, committee. Thirty-one of us on this rung and one hauler with a cracked ring frame between the lot of us. We are not asking to go first. We are asking to be counted.]

context: Response text — granting the strike committee a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [You are on the manifest. Get your people to the climber head.]
de: Du bist auf dem Manifest. Bringen Sie Ihre Leute zum Kletterkopf.
de_source: [You are on the manifest. Get your people to the climber head.]

context: Response text — refusing the strike committee a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [The lift is spoken for. You are staying on the rung.]
de: Für den Lift wird gesprochen. Du bleibst auf der Sprosse.
de_source: [The lift is spoken for. You are staying on the rung.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Say that again on the record. — Right. Thirty-one, moving now. Nobody who matters is going to thank you for this, Destroyer. We will.]
de: Sagen Sie das noch einmal im Protokoll. - Richtig. Einunddreißig, jetzt in Bewegung. Niemand, der zählt, wird dir dafür danken, Zerstörer. Wir werden.
de_source: [Say that again on the record. — Right. Thirty-one, moving now. Nobody who matters is going to thank you for this, Destroyer. We will.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Understood. We will get the gear off the arm and find ourselves a wall.]
de: verstanden. Wir werden die Ausrüstung vom Arm nehmen und eine Wand finden.
de_source: [Understood. We will get the gear off the arm and find ourselves a wall.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will hold. We have got very good at holding.]
de: Wir werden weitermachen. Wir sind sehr gut darin, durchzuhalten.
de_source: [We will hold. We have got very good at holding.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock ask for a lift in the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, Havelock Cutter. Twenty-two units, and I will say plainly what it buys you. This depot chain is company-run, and the next Alliance hull through this corridor books its fuel through us. Our people are staff, not cargo.]
de: Zerstörer, Havelock Cutter. Zweiundzwanzig Einheiten, und ich werde klar sagen, was es Ihnen kauft. Diese Depotkette wird von Unternehmen geführt, und die nächste Allianz, die durch diesen Korridor schleudert, bucht ihren Treibstoff durch uns. Unsere Leute sind Personal, nicht Fracht.
de_source: [Destroyer, Havelock Cutter. Twenty-two units, and I will say plainly what it buys you. This depot chain is company-run, and the next Alliance hull through this corridor books its fuel through us. Our people are staff, not cargo.]

context: Response text — granting Havelock a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock has the second slot. Load your people.]
de: Havelock hat den zweiten Slot. Lade dein Volk.
de_source: [Havelock has the second slot. Load your people.]

context: Response text — refusing Havelock a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Your staff can sit it out with everyone else. Havelock is not on the manifest.]
de: Ihre Mitarbeiter können es mit allen anderen aussitzen. Havelock ist nicht auf dem manifest.
de_source: [Your staff can sit it out with everyone else. Havelock is not on the manifest.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Noted, and logged. You will find us reasonable the next time you come through this corridor.]
de: Notiert und protokolliert. Sie werden uns vernünftig finden, wenn Sie das nächste Mal durch diesen Korridor kommen.
de_source: [Noted, and logged. You will find us reasonable the next time you come through this corridor.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [That is your decision to make. I will make quite sure it is recorded as yours.]
de: Das ist Ihre Entscheidung. Ich werde dafür sorgen, dass es als Ihre aufgezeichnet wird.
de_source: [That is your decision to make. I will make quite sure it is recorded as yours.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will wait. We are good at waiting, Destroyer, and better at remembering.]
de: Wir werden warten. Wir sind gut im Warten, Zerstörer, und besser im Erinnern.
de_source: [We will wait. We are good at waiting, Destroyer, and better at remembering.]

context: Response text — confronting Havelock with the record while protecting the witness in Falling Skyway
en: [Your file says that arm was inspected. I have somebody who was standing on it that week. You do not get their name.]
de: Ihre Akte sagt, dass der Arm inspiziert wurde. Ich habe jemanden, der in dieser Woche darauf stand. Sie bekommen ihren Namen nicht.
de_source: [Your file says that arm was inspected. I have somebody who was standing on it that week. You do not get their name.]

context: Response text — confronting Havelock with the record and naming the witness in Falling Skyway
en: [Your file says that arm was inspected. Rigger Tacket was standing on it that week and says nobody came up.]
de: Ihre Akte sagt, dass der Arm inspiziert wurde. Rigger Tacket stand in dieser Woche darauf und sagt, dass niemand gekommen ist.
de_source: [Your file says that arm was inspected. Rigger Tacket was standing on it that week and says nobody came up.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock answering a confrontation with no name attached in Falling Skyway
en: [Then produce them. No? Then it is an allegation from a hull that has been on station four hours. This channel is closed to you.]
de: Und dann produzieren Sie sie. Nein? Dann ist es eine Behauptung von einem Rumpf, der vier Stunden auf der Station war. Dieser Kanal ist für dich geschlossen.
de_source: [Then produce them. No? Then it is an allegation from a hull that has been on station four hours. This channel is closed to you.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock answering a confrontation with the witness named in Falling Skyway
en: [Tacket. Yes. She is on our books — or she was. Thank you, Destroyer. You have saved our people a great deal of looking.]
de: Tacket. Ja. Sie steht in unseren Büchern - oder sie war es. Danke, Zerstörer. Sie haben unserem Volk viel Aufmerksamkeit erspart.
de_source: [Tacket. Yes. She is on our books — or she was. Thank you, Destroyer. You have saved our people a great deal of looking.]

context: Dialogue body — the civilian convoy ask for a lift in the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway, Meridian, convoy lead. Twenty-six. That is four hulls and the families in them, and I know it is the biggest number on your board. I have nothing to offer you for it. I would not know what to offer.]
de: Skyway, Meridian, Konvoi führen. 26. Das sind vier Rümpfe und die Familien in ihnen, und ich weiß, es ist die größte Zahl auf Ihrem Board. Dafür habe ich Ihnen nichts anzubieten. Ich weiß nicht, was ich anbieten soll.
de_source: [Skyway, Meridian, convoy lead. Twenty-six. That is four hulls and the families in them, and I know it is the biggest number on your board. I have nothing to offer you for it. I would not know what to offer.]

context: Response text — granting the convoy a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian, bring your hulls up. All four of them.]
de: Meridian, bring deine Rümpfe hoch. Alle vier.
de_source: [Meridian, bring your hulls up. All four of them.]

context: Response text — refusing the convoy a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian, I cannot take you. Get your hulls tight against the rung and ride it out.]
de: Meridian, ich kann dich nicht nehmen. Halten Sie Ihre Rümpfe fest gegen die Sprosse und reiten Sie sie aus.
de_source: [Meridian, I cannot take you. Get your hulls tight against the rung and ride it out.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Say again? — All four. Understood, Skyway. Understood. We are moving.]
de: Nochmals? – Alle vier. Verstanden, Skyway. verstanden. Wir bewegen uns.
de_source: [Say again? — All four. Understood, Skyway. Understood. We are moving.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Understood. We will tuck in as close as they will let us. Thank you for saying it yourself.]
de: verstanden. Wir werden so nah dranbleiben, wie sie es uns erlauben. Vielen Dank, dass Sie es selbst sagen.
de_source: [Understood. We will tuck in as close as they will let us. Thank you for saying it yourself.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will stand by. There is nowhere else to stand.]
de: Wir werden zusehen. Es gibt nirgendwo anders zu stehen.
de_source: [We will stand by. There is nowhere else to stand.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer — committee. There is no climber and we all heard Control say so. If there is a mooring left on A with power at it we have people who will not last the night in the open.]
de: Zerstörer — Ausschuss. Es gibt keinen Kletterer und wir alle haben Control so gehört. Wenn es auf A noch ein Festmachen mit Macht gibt, haben wir Leute, die die Nacht im Freien nicht überstehen werden.
de_source: [Destroyer — committee. There is no climber and we all heard Control say so. If there is a mooring left on A with power at it we have people who will not last the night in the open.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Cutter. The head is finished, so let us be practical. A is company plant, there is one berth on it, and neither of us is going to pretend that is a coincidence.]
de: Havelock Cutter. Der Kopf ist fertig, also lassen Sie uns praktisch sein. A ist Firmenfabrik, es gibt einen Anlegeplatz darauf, und keiner von uns wird so tun, als wäre das ein Zufall.
de_source: [Havelock Cutter. The head is finished, so let us be practical. A is company plant, there is one berth on it, and neither of us is going to pretend that is a coincidence.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. We are not asking for the lift any more. We are asking for a wall.]
de: Meridian. Wir fordern den Aufzug nicht mehr. Wir fordern eine Mauer.
de_source: [Meridian. We are not asking for the lift any more. We are asking for a wall.]

context: Dialogue body — Control offering the one remaining Ladder A berth in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: there is no lift and there is not going to be. What is left on this corridor is one mooring on Ladder A with power at it and three parties who want it. That one is not arithmetic, Destroyer. Give me a name.]
de: Skyway Control: Es gibt keinen Aufzug und es wird keinen geben. Was auf diesem Korridor übrig bleibt, ist ein Ankerplatz auf der Leiter A mit Strom und drei Parteien, die es wollen. Das ist keine Arithmetik, Zerstörer. Gib mir einen Namen.
de_source: [Skyway Control: there is no lift and there is not going to be. What is left on this corridor is one mooring on Ladder A with power at it and three parties who want it. That one is not arithmetic, Destroyer. Give me a name.]

context: Dialogue body — Control with no berth left to offer at all in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: no lift and Ladder A is in no state to tie anybody up either. There is nothing on this corridor to give away tonight. Log it and take your ship home.]
de: Skyway Control: Kein Lift und Ladder A ist auch nicht in der Lage, jemanden zu binden. Auf diesem Korridor gibt es heute Abend nichts zu verschenken. Loggen Sie es und nehmen Sie Ihr Schiff nach Hause.
de_source: [Skyway Control: no lift and Ladder A is in no state to tie anybody up either. There is nothing on this corridor to give away tonight. Log it and take your ship home.]

context: Dialogue body — Control after the last berth has been allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [The berth is allocated, Destroyer. Nothing further from this station.]
de: Der Liegeplatz ist zugeteilt, Zerstörer. Nichts weiter von dieser Station.
de_source: [The berth is allocated, Destroyer. Nothing further from this station.]

context: Response text — giving the last berth to the strike committee in Falling Skyway
de: Der Liegeplatz geht an den Ausschuss.

context: Response text — giving the last berth to Havelock in Falling Skyway
Response text — giving the last berth to the convoy in Falling Skyway
de: Der Liegeplatz geht zu Meridians Konvoi.

context: Response text — holding the last berth clear in Falling Skyway
en: [The berth stays clear. Ladder A is the last working rung on this corridor and I will not have it blocked.]
de: Der Liegeplatz bleibt klar. Leiter A ist die letzte Arbeitsstufe auf diesem Korridor und ich werde sie nicht blockieren lassen.
de_source: [The berth stays clear. Ladder A is the last working rung on this corridor and I will not have it blocked.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to the strike committee in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: committee to Ladder A. I will let the other two know whose call it was.]
de: Logged: Komitee zu Ladder A. Ich werde die anderen beiden wissen lassen, wessen Anruf es war.
de_source: [Logged: committee to Ladder A. I will let the other two know whose call it was.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to Havelock in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: Havelock to Ladder A. That will read tidily in their report and badly in everyone else's.]
de: Geloggt: Havelock zu Ladder A. Das wird sich in ihrem Bericht ordentlich und in dem aller anderen schlecht lesen.
de_source: [Logged: Havelock to Ladder A. That will read tidily in their report and badly in everyone else's.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to the convoy in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: Meridian to Ladder A. Four hulls into a berth built for one. They will manage or they will not.]
de: Logged: Meridian zu Ladder A. Vier Rümpfe in einen für einen gebauten Liegeplatz. Sie werden es schaffen oder nicht.
de_source: [Logged: Meridian to Ladder A. Four hulls into a berth built for one. They will manage or they will not.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth held clear in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: berth held clear. Somebody up the line will want that reasoning in writing, Destroyer, and you had better have some.]
de: Geloggt: Liegeplatz klar gehalten. Jemand auf der ganzen Linie wird diese Argumentation schriftlich wollen, Zerstörer, und Sie sollten besser einige haben.
de_source: [Logged: berth held clear. Somebody up the line will want that reasoning in writing, Destroyer, and you had better have some.]

context: Dialogue body — Control standing by for a berth decision in Falling Skyway
en: [Standing by, Destroyer. The weather is not.]
de: Standing by, Zerstörer. Das Wetter ist es nicht.
de_source: [Standing by, Destroyer. The weather is not.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee to Destroyer. All accounted for. Cold, and all accounted for, which is more than any of us expected when this started.]
de: Komitee zum Zerstörer. Alles berücksichtigt. Kalt, und alles berücksichtigt, was mehr ist, als jeder von uns erwartet hat, als dies begann.
de_source: [Committee to Destroyer. All accounted for. Cold, and all accounted for, which is more than any of us expected when this started.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee. We got most of them behind the pump housing before it came through. Most. Do not ask me for a number tonight, Destroyer.]
de: Ausschuss. Wir haben die meisten von ihnen hinter dem Pumpengehäuse, bevor es durchkam. Die meisten. Frag mich heute Abend nicht nach einer Zahl, Zerstörer.
de_source: [Committee. We got most of them behind the pump housing before it came through. Most. Do not ask me for a number tonight, Destroyer.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee naming the broken safe-passage promise in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee. You gave us your word the corridor would be clear for our people in the transfer window. We wrote it down. I read it out to the floor myself and they voted on it. Then we watched that window shut with our people still standing on the rung. Whatever else you take off this rock, Destroyer, take that with you.]
de: Ausschuss. Du hast uns dein Wort gegeben, der Korridor wäre für unsere Leute im Transferfenster klar. Wir haben es aufgeschrieben. Ich habe es selbst vorgelesen, und sie haben darüber abgestimmt. Dann sahen wir, wie sich das Fenster schloss und unser Volk noch auf der Sprosse stand. Was auch immer du sonst noch von diesem Felsen nimmst, Zerstörer, nimm das mit dir.
de_source: [Committee. You gave us your word the corridor would be clear for our people in the transfer window. We wrote it down. I read it out to the floor myself and they voted on it. Then we watched that window shut with our people still standing on the rung. Whatever else you take off this rock, Destroyer, take that with you.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Cutter. Our staff sheltered aboard. The company will want a report and the report will have your name at the top of it.]
de: Havelock Cutter. Unsere Mitarbeiter sind an Bord geschützt. Das Unternehmen wird einen Bericht wollen und der Bericht wird Ihren Namen an der Spitze haben.
de_source: [Havelock Cutter. Our staff sheltered aboard. The company will want a report and the report will have your name at the top of it.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock. We lost people on that rung tonight. There will be an inquiry, and I will be asked who was in the corridor and what they did with the lift.]
de: Havelock. Wir haben heute Abend Menschen auf dieser Sprosse verloren. Es wird eine Untersuchung geben, und ich werde gefragt, wer im Flur war und was sie mit dem Aufzug gemacht haben.
de_source: [Havelock. We lost people on that rung tonight. There will be an inquiry, and I will be asked who was in the corridor and what they did with the lift.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. Four hulls, all still here. Scoured back to the frames and all still here. We will take that.]
de: Meridian. Vier Rümpfe, alle noch hier. Zurück zu den Frames und alle noch hier. Wir werden das nehmen.
de_source: [Meridian. Four hulls, all still here. Scoured back to the frames and all still here. We will take that.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. We lost the third hull. Everyone aboard her was somebody's. I am not going to say anything else on an open channel.]
de: Meridian. Wir haben den dritten Rumpf verloren. Jeder an Bord war jemandes. Ich werde nichts anderes auf einem offenen Kanal sagen.
de_source: [Meridian. We lost the third hull. Everyone aboard her was somebody's. I am not going to say anything else on an open channel.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with the committee and the convoy carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Meridian convoy carried, Havelock Operations not carried. The corridor is shut and the record stands as flown. Every party on it now knows exactly what this ship decided when it could only decide once.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Manifest liest: Streikkomitee getragen, Meridian-Konvoi getragen, Havelock-Operationen nicht getragen. Der Korridor ist geschlossen und der Rekord steht wie geflogen. Jede Partei darauf weiß jetzt genau, was dieses Schiff entschieden hat, als es nur einmal entscheiden konnte.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Meridian convoy carried, Havelock Operations not carried. The corridor is shut and the record stands as flown. Every party on it now knows exactly what this ship decided when it could only decide once.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with the committee and Havelock carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy not carried. The corridor is shut. The two parties with something to trade are off this rock and the one with nothing is still on it, and it is filed in those words.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Manifest liest: Streikkomitee getragen, Havelock Operationen getragen, Meridian Konvoi nicht getragen. Der Korridor ist geschlossen. Die beiden Parteien mit etwas zu handeln sind von diesem Felsen und die mit nichts ist immer noch auf sie, und es ist in diesen Worten archiviert.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy not carried. The corridor is shut. The two parties with something to trade are off this rock and the one with nothing is still on it, and it is filed in those words.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with Havelock and the convoy carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy carried, strike committee not carried. The corridor is shut. The people who told you what was wrong with this ladder are the people still standing on it.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Manifest liest: Havelock Operationen durchgeführt, Meridian Konvoi durchgeführt, Streikkomitee nicht durchgeführt. Der Korridor ist geschlossen. Die Leute, die dir gesagt haben, was mit dieser Leiter nicht stimmt, sind die Leute, die immer noch darauf stehen.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy carried, strike committee not carried. The corridor is shut. The people who told you what was wrong with this ladder are the people still standing on it.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with only one claim carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads one claim carried out of three, against lift that would have taken two. The corridor is shut, and that difference is filed against this ship rather than against the ladder.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Manifest liest einen Anspruch von drei, gegen Aufzug, der zwei genommen hätte. Der Korridor ist geschlossen, und dieser Unterschied wird gegen dieses Schiff und nicht gegen die Leiter eingereicht.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads one claim carried out of three, against lift that would have taken two. The corridor is shut, and that difference is filed against this ship rather than against the ladder.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with nothing carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads nothing carried. There was lift in this window and it went up the ribbon empty. The corridor is shut and all three claims stand unmet.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Manifest liest nichts getragen. Es gab Lift in diesem Fenster und es ging das Band leer. Der Korridor ist geschlossen und alle drei Ansprüche bleiben unerfüllt.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads nothing carried. There was lift in this window and it went up the ribbon empty. The corridor is shut and all three claims stand unmet.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing a window with no lift after a berth was allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift ran in this corridor tonight. One mooring on Ladder A was allocated, two claims were not, and the rest of it is weather and paperwork. Log it and go.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Kein Lift lief heute Abend in diesem Korridor. Ein Ankerplatz auf der Leiter A wurde zugewiesen, zwei Ansprüche waren es nicht, und der Rest ist Wetter und Papierkram. Loggen Sie es und gehen Sie.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift ran in this corridor tonight. One mooring on Ladder A was allocated, two claims were not, and the rest of it is weather and paperwork. Log it and go.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing a window with no lift and no berth allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift, no mooring allocated, three claims standing. Nothing left this rock tonight and nothing on this corridor is better than it was when you arrived. The window is shut. Go home.]
de: Skyway Control, das Fenster schließen. Kein Aufzug, kein Festmachen zugewiesen, drei Ansprüche stehen. Nichts hat diesen Felsen heute Abend verlassen und nichts auf diesem Korridor ist besser als bei deiner Ankunft. Das Fenster ist geschlossen. Geh nach Hause.
de_source: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift, no mooring allocated, three claims standing. Nothing left this rock tonight and nothing on this corridor is better than it was when you arrived. The window is shut. Go home.]

context: Evidence text — Havelock put to their own maintenance record, Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Operations were put to their own maintenance record on the open channel during the transfer window.]
de: Havelock-Operationen wurden während des Transferfensters auf dem offenen Kanal auf ihre eigene Wartungsaufzeichnung gesetzt.
de_source: [Havelock Operations were put to their own maintenance record on the open channel during the transfer window.]

context: Evidence text — the strike committee left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [The strike committee were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered on the Ladder B rung. There were casualties.]
de: Das Streikkomitee wurde nicht im Transferfenster getragen und auf der Leiter B Sprosse geschützt. Es gab Opfer.
de_source: [The strike committee were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered on the Ladder B rung. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — Havelock staff left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Operations staff were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered aboard their own hulls. There were casualties.]
de: Die Mitarbeiter von Havelock Operations wurden nicht im Transferfenster befördert und an Bord ihrer eigenen Rümpfe geschützt. Es gab Opfer.
de_source: [Havelock Operations staff were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered aboard their own hulls. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — the convoy left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [Convoy Meridian were not carried in the transfer window and rode the corridor out in the open. There were casualties.]
de: Konvoi Meridian wurde nicht im Transferfenster getragen und fuhr den Korridor im Freien. Es gab Opfer.
de_source: [Convoy Meridian were not carried in the transfer window and rode the corridor out in the open. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — the filed evidence bundle followed by naming the witness to Havelock, Falling Skyway
en: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew later named Tacket to Havelock.]
de: Die Ladder-B-Scan-Diskrepanz und die Bestätigung von Rigger Tacket wurden mit Control unedited eingereicht. Die Besatzung nannte später Tacket nach Havelock.
de_source: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew later named Tacket to Havelock.]

context: Evidence text — the filed evidence bundle with the witness protected from Havelock, Falling Skyway
en: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew did not name Tacket to Havelock.]
de: Die Ladder-B-Scan-Diskrepanz und die Bestätigung von Rigger Tacket wurden mit Control unedited eingereicht. Die Besatzung nannte Tacket nicht Havelock.
de_source: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew did not name Tacket to Havelock.]

context: Evidence text — the discrepancy established but its evidence bundle not filed, Falling Skyway
en: [The crew established Ladder B's scan discrepancy but did not file the discrepancy and worker account with Control.]
de: Die Besatzung stellte die Scan-Diskrepanz von Ladder B fest, reichte jedoch das Diskrepanz- und Arbeiterkonto nicht bei Control ein.
de_source: [The crew established Ladder B's scan discrepancy but did not file the discrepancy and worker account with Control.]

context: Evidence text — no discrepancy established at all, Falling Skyway
en: [No discrepancy was established between Ladder B's condition and the operator's file on it. The claim stands unexamined.]
de: Es wurde keine Diskrepanz zwischen dem Zustand von Ladder B und der Datei des Betreibers festgestellt. Das Vorbringen bleibt ungeprüft.
de_source: [No discrepancy was established between Ladder B's condition and the operator's file on it. The claim stands unexamined.]

context: Evidence text — every commitment kept, Falling Skyway
en: [Every commitment this captain gave in the Skyway corridor was kept.]
de: Jede Verpflichtung, die dieser Kapitän im Skyway-Korridor gab, wurde eingehalten.
de_source: [Every commitment this captain gave in the Skyway corridor was kept.]

context: Evidence text — at least one commitment broken, Falling Skyway
en: [At least one commitment this captain gave in the Skyway corridor was broken.]
de: Mindestens eine Verpflichtung, die dieser Kapitän im Skyway-Korridor gab, wurde gebrochen.

context: Evidence text — no commitments made at all, Falling Skyway
en: [This captain gave no commitments in the Skyway corridor.]
de: Dieser Kapitän gab keine Verpflichtungen im Skyway-Korridor.
de_source: [This captain gave no commitments in the Skyway corridor.]

de: Das Board von Control hat sich gerade bewegt. Sind wir immer noch auf diesem manifest oder nicht?
de_source: [Control's board just moved. Are we still on that manifest or are we not?]

en: [The manifest has changed since we last spoke, Destroyer. Say plainly whether Havelock is on it.]
de: Das Manifest hat sich geändert, seit wir zuletzt gesprochen haben, Zerstörer. Sagen Sie einfach, ob Havelock darauf ist.

context: Phone join screen — a pasted full code did not have the expected three parts
en: [That code is not readable. Paste the whole thing or type the eight letters.]
de: Dieser Code ist nicht lesbar. Fügen Sie das Ganze ein oder geben Sie die acht Buchstaben ein.
de_source: [That code is not readable. Paste the whole thing or type the eight letters.]

context: Phone join screen — the typed code is a fleet/server code, not a crew one. Deliberately says nothing else about that session
en: [That is a fleet code. Ask the bridge for the crew code.]
de: Das ist ein Flottencode. Fragen Sie die Brücke nach dem Besatzungscode.
de_source: [That is a fleet code. Ask the bridge for the crew code.]

context: Phone join screen — no host is holding the typed code
en: [No ship is using that code. Check the viewscreen and try again.]
de: Kein Schiff benutzt diesen Code. Überprüfen Sie den Bildschirm und versuchen Sie es erneut.
de_source: [No ship is using that code. Check the viewscreen and try again.]

context: Phone join screen — the code belongs to a different release of the game than this phone is running
en: [That ship is running a different version. Reload this page and try again.]
de: Dieses Schiff betreibt eine andere Version. Laden Sie diese Seite neu und versuchen Sie es erneut.
de_source: [That ship is running a different version. Reload this page and try again.]

context: Phone join screen — the host has stopped admitting new joiners
en: [That ship has closed its crew list.]
de: Dieses Schiff hat seine Besatzungsliste geschlossen.
de_source: [That ship has closed its crew list.]

context: Phone join screen — the host disappeared while this phone was connected or connecting
Phone join screen — the code service could not produce a free code, which a guest can only respond to by retrying
en: [The join service is busy. Try again in a moment.]
de: Der Join Service ist beschäftigt. Versuchen Sie es gleich noch einmal.
de_source: [The join service is busy. Try again in a moment.]

context: Phone join screen — the join service itself could not be reached
en: [Cannot reach the join service. Check your connection.]
de: Kann den Join Service nicht erreichen. Überprüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung.
de_source: [Cannot reach the join service. Check your connection.]

context: Phone join screen — the pasted code's project GUID belongs to no Phoenix namespace at all, so it is neither a crew code nor a fleet one
en: [That is not a Phoenix join code.]
de: Das ist kein Phoenix Join Code.
de_source: [That is not a Phoenix join code.]

context: Phone join screen — the host refused this phone because the two are running different mission content, even though the protocol matches. Distinct from error_version, which is a different build
en: [That ship is running different content. Reload this page and try again.]
de: Dieses Schiff hat andere Inhalte. Laden Sie diese Seite neu und versuchen Sie es erneut.
de_source: [That ship is running different content. Reload this page and try again.]

context: Phone join screen — the host could not identify this phone's build at all, because the page carries no delivery stamp (an unbuilt or hand-copied bundle)
en: [This page could not tell the ship which build it is. Reload it from the ship's own address.]
de: Diese Seite konnte dem Schiff nicht sagen, welches es baut. Laden Sie es von der eigenen Adresse des Schiffes.
de_source: [This page could not tell the ship which build it is. Reload it from the ship's own address.]

context: Phone join screen — the join service cut this phone off after too many code attempts on one connection
en: [Too many tries. Reload this page and check the code on the viewscreen.]
de: Zu viele Versuche. Laden Sie diese Seite neu und überprüfen Sie den Code auf dem Bildschirm.
de_source: [Too many tries. Reload this page and check the code on the viewscreen.]

context: Phone join screen — the code is right and the ship is there, but its network is so restrictive that the join service is already carrying as many phones as it may for that ship. Distinct from error_closed, which is the crew list rather than the relay
en: [That ship's join service is carrying as many phones as it can. Ask someone to disconnect or try another network.]
de: Der Join-Service dieses Schiffes trägt so viele Telefone wie möglich. Bitten Sie jemanden, sich zu trennen oder ein anderes Netzwerk auszuprobieren.
de_source: [That ship's join service is carrying as many phones as it can. Ask someone to disconnect or try another network.]

context: Phone join screen — the join service stopped carrying this phone's traffic, or refused a frame it could not carry. A link failure rather than an answer about the code, so the page keeps retrying
en: [The join service stopped carrying this connection. Trying again.]
de: Der Join-Service hörte auf, diese Verbindung zu tragen. Noch einmal versuchen.
de_source: [The join service stopped carrying this connection. Trying again.]

context: Phone join screen — this page identified with a session token only the ship's own runtime may use, so the ship refused the connection. It cannot happen by accident from a phone; it means the stored token is wrong
en: [This device is using a reserved name. Clear this site's data and reload.]
de: Dieses Gerät verwendet einen reservierten Namen. Löschen Sie die Daten dieser Website und laden Sie neu.
de_source: [This device is using a reserved name. Clear this site's data and reload.]

context: Phone join screen — the host refused an invalid or changed session identity and retrying the same saved token cannot repair it
en: [This device's identity could not be accepted. Clear this site's data and reload.]
de: Die Identität dieses Geräts konnte nicht akzeptiert werden. Löschen Sie die Daten dieser Website und laden Sie neu.
de_source: [This device's identity could not be accepted. Clear this site's data and reload.]

context: Successor console — a takeover was attempted while the current fleet lead is still connected
en: [The fleet lead is still connected. Wait for that connection to end before taking over.]
de: Die Flottenleitung ist noch verbunden. Warten Sie bis ihre Verbindung endet bevor Sie übernehmen.
de_source: [The fleet lead is still connected. Wait for that connection to end before taking over.]

context: Successor console — this device did not present a valid frozen-fleet continuation proof
en: [This device cannot prove its place in the fleet. Check its saved fleet identity.]
de: Dieses Gerät kann seinen Platz in der Flotte nicht nachweisen. Prüfen Sie seine gespeicherte Flottenidentität.
de_source: [This device cannot prove its place in the fleet. Check its saved fleet identity.]

context: Successor console — this device is not the eligible connected successor or its takeover proof failed
en: [This device cannot take over the fleet with these credentials. An eligible successor must try.]
de: Dieses Gerät kann die Flotte mit diesen Zugangsdaten nicht übernehmen. Ein berechtigter Nachfolger muss es versuchen.
de_source: [This device cannot take over the fleet with these credentials. An eligible successor must try.]

context: Successor console — leadership changed since this continuation or takeover request was prepared
en: [The fleet changed leads. Refresh its state before trying again.]
de: Die Flottenleitung hat gewechselt. Aktualisieren Sie den Zustand bevor Sie es erneut versuchen.
de_source: [The fleet changed leads. Refresh its state before trying again.]

context: Successor console — this frozen-fleet slot is still held by another live connection
en: [Your fleet slot is still connected elsewhere. Disconnect it before continuing here.]
de: Ihr Flottenplatz ist noch anderswo verbunden. Trennen Sie diese Verbindung bevor Sie hier fortfahren.
de_source: [Your fleet slot is still connected elsewhere. Disconnect it before continuing here.]

context: Host viewscreen join panel — caption above the code a guest types into their phone
de: oder geben Sie diesen Code ein

context: Host viewscreen join panel — what it says INSTEAD of a QR when the host has no way in at all (phoenix-host --solo, or a host serving no client bundle and given no --rendezvous; since issue #1353 an ordinary host accepts LAN joins on its own port): there will never be a code, so a framed empty QR would invite a crew to scan something that cannot work
en: [Crew joining is off — this host has no join service.]
de: Crew join ist ausgeschaltet - dieser host hat keinen join-service.
de_source: [Crew joining is off — this host has no join service.]

context: Host viewscreen connection diagnostics — the join-code service could not be reached and nothing is re-registering, so there is no code, no QR and no link. Since issue #1112 retired PeerJS there is no second route: nobody can join at all until the service comes back
en: [No join-code service — nobody can join until it is back.]
de: Kein Join-Code-Service - niemand kann beitreten, bis er zurück ist.
de_source: [No join-code service — nobody can join until it is back.]

context: Host viewscreen connection diagnostics — the join-code service dropped and the host is re-registering on a backoff, but this is the FIRST-EVER registration attempt (issue #1115): there is no earlier code held to ask for back, so the one that arrives really will be a new one. See rendezvous_reclaiming for the ordinary case, an already-issued code reconnecting
en: [Join-code service dropped — reconnecting. A new code will appear here.]
de: Join-Code-Service fallen gelassen — Wiederverbindung. Ein neuer Code wird hier erscheinen.
de_source: [Join-code service dropped — reconnecting. A new code will appear here.]

context: Host viewscreen connection diagnostics — the join-code service dropped and the host is re-registering on a backoff, presenting the reclaim secret its own earlier code carried (issue #1115). Nobody can join in the meantime, but the letters already on screen and QR'd across the room should come back rather than being replaced
de: Join-code-service fallen gelassen — wiederverbindung ihres codes.

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket answering a first hail in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, you are close to a contracted lane hold. We are paid to sit here. Say what you want.]
de: Zerstörer, du bist in der Nähe einer kontrahierten Spur. Wir werden dafür bezahlt, hier zu sitzen. Sag, was du willst.
de_source: [Destroyer, you are close to a contracted lane hold. We are paid to sit here. Say what you want.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket after being told a boarding party is coming, Falling Skyway
en: [We heard you the first time. We are still here. Nothing has changed on our end.]
de: Wir haben dich das erste Mal gehört. Wir sind immer noch hier. An unserem Ende hat sich nichts geändert.
de_source: [We heard you the first time. We are still here. Nothing has changed on our end.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket after refusing to stand off, Falling Skyway
en: [Same answer as before, Destroyer. Ask again if it helps you sleep.]
de: Die gleiche Antwort wie zuvor, Zerstörer. Fragen Sie noch einmal, ob es Ihnen hilft zu schlafen.
de_source: [Same answer as before, Destroyer. Ask again if it helps you sleep.]

context: Dialogue body — the picket channel answering a stale response after the standoff is settled or the mission has closed, Falling Skyway
en: [That conversation is over. Nothing on this channel now.]
de: Das Gespräch ist vorbei. Nichts auf diesem Kanal jetzt.
de_source: [That conversation is over. Nothing on this channel now.]

context: Dialogue response — ask the Havelock picket to stand off the lane, Falling Skyway
en: [Take your boat off the lane. There are people waiting on it.]
de: Nehmen Sie Ihr Boot von der Spur. Es gibt Menschen, die darauf warten.
de_source: [Take your boat off the lane. There are people waiting on it.]

context: Dialogue response — warn the Havelock picket that a boarding party is coming and no guns will be used, Falling Skyway
en: [Understand this: we will come aboard you. We will not shoot you.]
de: Verstehen Sie dies: Wir werden an Bord kommen. Wir werden dich nicht erschießen.
de_source: [Understand this: we will come aboard you. We will not shoot you.]

context: Dialogue response — authorise Tactical force against the Havelock picket, Falling Skyway
en: [Tactical is authorised. Take their guns off them.]
de: Tactical ist zugelassen. Nimm ihnen die Waffen ab.
de_source: [Tactical is authorised. Take their guns off them.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket refusing to stand off, Falling Skyway
en: [No. The hold is contracted and we are not the ones who wrote it. Take it up with the cutter.]
de: Nein. Der Hold ist kontrahiert und wir sind nicht diejenigen, die ihn geschrieben haben. Nehmen Sie es mit dem Cutter auf.
de_source: [No. The hold is contracted and we are not the ones who wrote it. Take it up with the cutter.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket agreeing to leave the lane, Falling Skyway
en: […Right. We are not dying over a lane hold. Coming off station. The lane is yours.]
de: ...Recht. Wir sterben nicht über eine Lane Hold. Von der Station kommend. Die Lane gehört dir.
de_source: […Right. We are not dying over a lane hold. Coming off station. The lane is yours.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket hearing the force authorisation read to it, Falling Skyway
en: [Understood, Destroyer. On the record: you said that, not us.]
de: Verstanden, Zerstörer. Im Protokoll: Das haben Sie gesagt, nicht wir.
de_source: [Understood, Destroyer. On the record: you said that, not us.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket answering a repeated force authorisation, Falling Skyway
en: [You have already said it. We are not going to be told twice.]
de: Sie haben es bereits gesagt. Es wird uns nicht zweimal gesagt werden.
de_source: [You have already said it. We are not going to be told twice.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket's own crew after a Security team locks their mounts out, Falling Skyway
en: [Mounts are cold. Your people were civil about it. We are still here and we are still watching.]
de: Die Berge sind kalt. Ihre Leute waren darüber höflich. Wir sind immer noch hier und schauen immer noch zu.
de_source: [Mounts are cold. Your people were civil about it. We are still here and we are still watching.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket after a Security team comes aboard, Falling Skyway
en: [Your party has the bridge. Nobody died over it. Somebody is going to have to explain this to the office.]
de: Ihre Partei hat die Brücke. Niemand starb darüber. Jemand wird das dem Büro erklären müssen.
de_source: [Your party has the bridge. Nobody died over it. Somebody is going to have to explain this to the office.]

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket after its mounts are shot off, Falling Skyway
en: [Mounts are slag. We are still breathing, which I am told was a choice you made.]
de: Lager sind Schlacke. Wir atmen immer noch, was mir gesagt wurde, war eine Wahl, die Sie getroffen haben.
de_source: [Mounts are slag. We are still breathing, which I am told was a choice you made.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock operations on the picket being destroyed, Falling Skyway — the one report the boat cannot make itself
en: [There were four people on that boat. Do not hail this office again tonight.]
de: Es waren vier Menschen auf diesem Boot. Helfen Sie diesem Büro heute Abend nicht wieder.
de_source: [There were four people on that boat. Do not hail this office again tonight.]

context: Commitment terms — the captain's promise to the Havelock picket that it will be boarded and not shot, Falling Skyway
en: [The picket will be taken by boarding party and not by weapons fire.]
de: Der Streikposten wird vom Boarding Party und nicht durch Waffenfeuer genommen werden.
de_source: [The picket will be taken by boarding party and not by weapons fire.]

context: Commitment resolution condition — the picket-restraint promise in Falling Skyway
Dossier line — the lane-hold contract the Havelock picket reads out when it is warned, Falling Skyway

de: Die Picket-Besatzung zitierte eine Spurhalteklausel, die von Havelock-Operationen bezahlt wurde, nicht vom Depot.
de_source: [Picket crew cited a lane-hold clause paid by Havelock operations, not by the depot.]

de: Von außen verschlossene Lager. Ihre Crew ging davon weg.

context: Post-mission report row outcome — a Security team went aboard and took the picket, and somebody aboard her was hurt

de: Vom Boarding Party genommen. Einer von ihnen tat weh, dorthin zu gelangen.
de_source: [Taken by boarding party. One of theirs hurt getting there.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — a Security team went aboard and took the picket after a warning on the channel, and nobody was hurt

de: Vom Boarding Party genommen. Sie wurden gewarnt und niemand wurde verletzt.
de_source: [Taken by boarding party. They were warned, and nobody was hurt.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the picket's guns were shot off and the engagement ended there

de: Gewehre schossen sie ab und das Schießen hörte auf. Sie schwebt immer noch.
de_source: [Guns shot off her and the shooting stopped. She is still floating.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the picket was talked off the lane and left under its own power

de: Sprechen Sie von der Spur. Sie flog ganz nach Hause.
de_source: [Talked off the lane. She flew home whole.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the picket was destroyed
de: Zerstört mit ihrer Besatzung an Bord.

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the crew opened fire on the picket, settled nothing and left her on station
en: [Fired on and left standing. The lane stayed hers, and she has the holes to show for it.]
de: Gefeuert und links stehend. Die Spur blieb ihr, und sie hat die Löcher, um dafür zu zeigen.
de_source: [Fired on and left standing. The lane stayed hers, and she has the holes to show for it.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the crew opened the channel and left the picket where it was
en: [Hailed and left standing. The lane stayed hers.]
de: Hailed und links stehend. Die Spur blieb ihre.
de_source: [Hailed and left standing. The lane stayed hers.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — nobody ever addressed the standoff
en: [Never addressed. She was still on station when the shutters came down.]
de: Nie angesprochen. Sie war immer noch auf der station, als die läden herunterkamen.

de: Ein Arbeiter hat es zu Protokoll gegeben. Der Fall hält.

de: Die Depotaufzeichnung zeigt den Fehler. Es steht auf dem Papier.
de_source: [The depot record shows the fault. It stands on paper.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the survey was filed with Control but turned up nothing to hang a case on
en: [Survey filed. Nothing on the record to hang a case on.]
de: Erhebung eingereicht. Nichts auf dem Protokoll, um einen Fall aufzuhängen.
de_source: [Survey filed. Nothing on the record to hang a case on.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — no complete survey ever reached Control

de: Keine Umfrage erreichte die Kontrolle. Der Korridor ging auf das Wort des Betreibers.
de_source: [No survey reached Control. The corridor went on the operator's word.]

context: Post-mission report row heading (issue #1351) — how the Ladder B strike was settled
Post-mission report row outcome — the strike was talked to a settlement
en: [Talked to a vote. The rung went back to work on its own terms.]

de_source: [Talked to a vote. The rung went back to work on its own terms.]

context: Post-mission report row outcome — the picket was cleared over the workers' heads

en: [Strike: Gunnery enables ship-wide boost. Fired attacks spend charge for damage only; range, accuracy and cooldown do not change.]
de: Angriff: Geschütz aktiviert die Verstärkung für das ganze Schiff. Abgefeuerte Waffen verbrauchen Reserveenergie nur für zusätzlichen Schaden; Reichweite, Treffgenauigkeit und Abklingzeit bleiben unverändert.
de_source: [Strike: Gunnery enables ship-wide boost. Fired attacks spend charge for damage only; range, accuracy and cooldown do not change.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [Recover: an underfunded attack still fires normally and switches boost off. Withdraw, restore the ship and recharge; Gunnery must enable boost again.]
de: Erholung: Reicht die Reserveenergie nicht aus, feuert der Angriff normal und die Verstärkung schaltet sich aus. Ziehen Sie sich zurück, reparieren Sie das Schiff und laden Sie die Reserve auf. Geschütz muss die Verstärkung erneut aktivieren.
de_source: [Recover: an underfunded attack still fires normally and switches boost off. Withdraw, restore the ship and recharge; Gunnery must enable boost again.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [Power prepares charge; Command, Sensors and Helm coordinate the approach; Gunnery enables boost for the attack. If charge cannot fund a shot it fires normally and boost switches off. Withdraw, restore and recharge before enabling boost again.]
de: Energie lädt die Angriffsreserve. Kommando, Sensorik und Steuerung koordinieren die Annäherung. Geschütz aktiviert die Verstärkung für den Angriff. Reicht die Reserveenergie für einen Schuss nicht aus, feuert er normal und die Verstärkung schaltet sich aus. Ziehen Sie sich zurück, reparieren Sie das Schiff und laden Sie die Reserve auf, bevor Sie die Verstärkung erneut aktivieren.
de_source: [Power prepares charge; Command, Sensors and Helm coordinate the approach; Gunnery enables boost for the attack. If charge cannot fund a shot it fires normally and boost switches off. Withdraw, restore and recharge before enabling boost again.]

en: [Unstaffed roles use ordinary Backfill. Take the Stations you need; the other roles continue through the same power, movement and weapon rules. The guide never reserves a Station or waits for six humans.]
de: Unbesetzte Rollen übernimmt die normale KI-Besetzung. Besetzen Sie die Stationen, die Sie brauchen; die übrigen Rollen folgen denselben Regeln für Energie, Bewegung und Waffen. Der Leitfaden reserviert keine Station und wartet nicht auf sechs Menschen.

en: [The reserve is charging from its assigned generation. Raising that allocation leaves less for other groups. Reduce charging to hold stored charge while supplying the attack or recovery.]
de: Die Angriffsreserve lädt sich aus der ihr zugeteilten Erzeugungsleistung auf. Eine höhere Zuteilung lässt weniger Energie für andere Gruppen übrig. Senken Sie die Ladezuteilung, um gespeicherte Reserveenergie zu halten und zugleich Angriff oder Erholung zu versorgen.
de_source: [The reserve is charging from its assigned generation. Raising that allocation leaves less for other groups. Reduce charging to hold stored charge while supplying the attack or recovery.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [Stored charge is available, but boosting is a Gunnery decision. Enable ship-wide boost with the ordinary toggle. Each fired weapon pays its own cost; refused fire attempts spend nothing.]
de: Reserveenergie ist gespeichert, aber Geschütz entscheidet über die Verstärkung. Aktivieren Sie die schiffsweite Verstärkung mit dem normalen Schalter. Jede abgefeuerte Waffe verbraucht ihre eigenen Kosten; verweigerte Feuerbefehle verbrauchen nichts.
de_source: [Stored charge is available, but boosting is a Gunnery decision. Enable ship-wide boost with the ordinary toggle. Each fired weapon pays its own cost; refused fire attempts spend nothing.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [Every firing weapon now attempts to pay its cost for extra damage. Turning boost off preserves the remaining reserve. An underfunded attack fires normally and switches boost off for the whole ship.]
de: Jede feuernde Waffe versucht nun, ihre Kosten aus der Angriffsreserve für zusätzlichen Schaden zu bezahlen. Schalten Sie die Verstärkung aus, bleibt die restliche Reserveenergie erhalten. Reicht sie für einen Angriff nicht aus, feuert er normal und die Verstärkung schaltet sich für das ganze Schiff aus.
de_source: [Every firing weapon now attempts to pay its cost for extra damage. Turning boost off preserves the remaining reserve. An underfunded attack fires normally and switches boost off for the whole ship.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [A fired attack could not pay its boost cost, so it fired normally and disabled boost. Any remaining charge is retained. Power can recharge while Helm withdraws and Damage Control repairs; Gunnery must enable boost again.]
de: Ein abgefeuerter Angriff konnte seine Verstärkungskosten nicht decken. Er feuerte normal und schaltete die Verstärkung aus. Verbleibende Reserveenergie bleibt erhalten. Energie kann die Reserve aufladen, während Steuerung den Rückzug fliegt und Schadenskontrolle repariert; Geschütz muss die Verstärkung erneut aktivieren.
de_source: [A fired attack could not pay its boost cost, so it fired normally and disabled boost. Any remaining charge is retained. Power can recharge while Helm withdraws and Damage Control repairs; Gunnery must enable boost again.]

context: Dynasty role and attack-cycle onboarding
en: [Set the attack intent and coordinate the bridge. You own the viewscreen, red alert and communications; Helm flies and Gunnery fires.]
de: Legen Sie die Angriffsabsicht fest und koordinieren Sie die Brücke. Sie führen den Hauptbildschirm, den Roten Alarm und die Kommunikation; Steuerung fliegt, und Geschütz feuert.
de_source: [Set the attack intent and coordinate the bridge. You own the viewscreen, red alert and communications; Helm flies and Gunnery fires.]

en: [Plot the approach on Navigation and fly it with thrust, steering, impulse and boost. Keep an escape route ready while Power balances propulsion against reserve charging.]
de: Planen Sie die Annäherung auf Navigation und fliegen Sie sie mit Schub, Steuerung, Impuls und Boost. Halten Sie einen Rückzugsweg bereit, während Energie den Antrieb gegen das Aufladen der Angriffsreserve abwägt.
de_source: [Plot the approach on Navigation and fly it with thrust, steering, impulse and boost. Keep an escape route ready while Power balances propulsion against reserve charging.]

en: [Select targets and operate ordinary weapons. Enable the ship-wide strike boost when ready to spend reserve charge. Every weapon spends its authored cost only when it fires.]
de: Wählen Sie Ziele und bedienen Sie die normalen Waffen. Aktivieren Sie die schiffsweite Angriffsverstärkung, wenn Sie Reserveenergie einsetzen wollen. Jede Waffe verbraucht ihre festgelegten Kosten erst beim tatsächlichen Feuern.
de_source: [Select targets and operate ordinary weapons. Enable the ship-wide strike boost when ready to spend reserve charge. Every weapon spends its authored cost only when it fires.]

en: [Detect and scan contacts. Give Command and Gunnery useful target information before the approach, and watch for threats during withdrawal.]
de: Erfassen und scannen Sie Kontakte. Geben Sie Kommando und Geschütz vor der Annäherung nützliche Zielinformationen und achten Sie beim Rückzug auf Bedrohungen.
de_source: [Detect and scan contacts. Give Command and Gunnery useful target information before the approach, and watch for threats during withdrawal.]

en: [Allocate generation to the strike reserve. Charging competes with propulsion, weapons and shields; it does not collect unused power automatically. Stored charge remains until Gunnery spends it.]
de: Teilen Sie der Angriffsreserve Erzeugungsleistung zu. Das Aufladen konkurriert mit Antrieb, Waffen und Schilden; ungenutzte Energie fließt nicht automatisch in die Reserve. Gespeicherte Reserveenergie bleibt, bis Geschütz sie verbraucht.
de_source: [Allocate generation to the strike reserve. Charging competes with propulsion, weapons and shields; it does not collect unused power automatically. Stored charge remains until Gunnery spends it.]

en: [Focus shields and dispatch repair teams. Report protection and repair needs to Power, and restore the ship while Helm withdraws for the next attack.]
de: Richten Sie die Schilde aus und entsenden Sie Reparaturteams. Melden Sie Energie den Schutz- und Reparaturbedarf und stellen Sie das Schiff wieder her, während Steuerung für den nächsten Angriff den Rückzug fliegt.
de_source: [Focus shields and dispatch repair teams. Report protection and repair needs to Power, and restore the ship while Helm withdraws for the next attack.]
